interface.shortDescription: Growth OS: ads, SEO, AI search
interface.longDescription:
OneLence is the growth operating system for small teams. It watches your whole growth engine (website journeys and conversions, ad platforms, search, AI assistants and affiliate partners) and tells you what deserves attention, what to do about it and how sure it is, even when attribution is incomplete.

Ask for today's priorities, what to scale, hold or stop and why, how ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity see your site (Premium), which search pages to improve first (Premium), which affiliates actually convert, or log a budget change and let OneLence watch what follows. In a codebase, the plugin installs OneLence tracking and verifies that events arrive.

Safe by design: nothing changes without your confirmation, and OneLence never touches your ad accounts or moves money. New to OneLence? Start a 7-day free trial at onelence.com.

How do AI assistants like ChatGPT see our site?
